samples.summary: Engine hardening well past the task's stated "pure wiring" scope, and it changes document behaviour on import. The originating task (`docs/tasks/active/20260829-docs-surface-existing-features-todo.md:3-5`) says "This task is pure wiring: no new document behaviour, no new file formats, no new model fields." This diff rewrites `resolvePageSetup` from a pass-through into a validating/clamping read path (proportional margin refitting, `MIN_CONTENT_PX`), makes `parsePageSetup` drop/clamp `<w:sectPr>` geometry a `.docx` legitimately carries (Word permits margins larger than the page; those are now proportionally shrunk), and reroutes both exporters through the resolver. None of it is in the task plan, the Review file list, or any of the three recorded review rounds. The cost stays inside the codebase plus a fidelity change on DOCX import that no design doc records.

samples.summary: The acceptance criterion "The keyboard shortcuts behave exactly as before" is ticked, but `Mod+Shift+C` no longer behaves as before: `copyFormat()` reads from `formatSourcePosition()` (first *selected* character, with block-end walk-forward and table-rectangle handling) instead of the caret, and the captured buffer now drops `href`/`image`/`pageNumber`. The structural-key drop is recorded in the task's follow-ups; the source-position change is not recorded anywhere. Both are plausible improvements, but they are behaviour changes shipped under a criterion that promises none.

samples.summary: URL-emission policy now exists in three divergent places: `isSafeUrl` in `@wafflebase/core/url` (the shared primitive), the new `isEmittableUrl`/`isLiteralDestination`/`SAFE_IMAGE_DATA_URI` block in the docs Markdown serializer, and `PdfPainter`'s bare `isSafeUrl` call (which the diff itself documents as carrying an unfixed parser-differential defect, #988). The reusable half — literal-destination checking, relative-reference acceptance, safe image data URIs — is ~150 lines living in one serializer rather than beside the shared primitive it wraps, so Sheets' link rendering and the PDF path cannot reuse it and the answers to "is this URL safe to emit" will keep diverging.

samples.summary: `getStore()` now returns a `Proxy` over `DocStore` that replaces exactly one method, memoizes bound members and traps `set`, while its own comment states it is not an access-control boundary and defers the real problem to #989. For a task scoped as "pure wiring", introducing a proxy layer over the store handle to defend one write is a heavier abstraction than the invariant needs (the same guard already lives on `EditorAPI.setPageSetup`), and it leaves a handle that is half-guarded by design.
